administration.populationCaution: Adult research-only is a conservative project use boundary, not proof of validation in Chinese adults, teachers or minors.
administration.instructionSourceNote: Official administration sample is a suggestion, not a mandatory standardized instruction. General present self-description retained. Project wording does not repeat unsupported absolute confidentiality or require same-sex comparisons.
administration.instructionEnExcerpt: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future.

scoring.missing: Require all 10 integer responses in 1..5; no imputation. Conservative project rule, not an official missingness rule.

norms.note: No cutoffs, diagnostic bands, Chinese percentiles or school norms are supported by the reviewed official pages. Do not use response-range thirds as empirical thresholds.

nameZh: IPIP消极情绪表达10题（研究译稿）
attribution: Barchard (2001), as attributed by the official IPIP key; do not claim a complete emotional-intelligence battery.

items.en: Shout or scream when I'm angry.
Can't help but look upset when something bad happens.
items.zh: 发生不好的事情时，我会不由自主地显露出难受的样子。
我会把害怕的感受表现出来。

items.en: Suspect that my facial expressions give me away when I feel sad.
items.zh: 难过时，我觉得自己的表情会流露出这种感受。
我会把悲伤的感受表现出来。

items.en: Keep my feelings to myself, regardless of how unhappy I am.
items.zh: 不管有多不开心，我都把感受藏在心里。

items.en: Find it difficult showing people that I'm angry with them.
items.zh: 我很难向别人表现出我在生他们的气。

items.en: Keep my feelings to myself, regardless of how scared I am.
items.zh: 不管有多害怕，我都把感受藏在心里。

items.en: Wish I could more easily show my negative feelings.
items.zh: 我希望自己能更容易地表达消极情绪。

reliability.interpretation: Official English-source group coefficients, women N=432 and men N=317; not evidence of Chinese reliability, individual accuracy or normative thresholds.

construct: Self-reported outward expression versus concealment of negative emotions; not symptom severity, aggression diagnosis, emotional regulation skill or a universally desirable direction.

feedback.summary: 这份回答关注的是：难过、害怕或生气时，别人有多容易看见你的感受。它不是在判断你是不是“情绪不好的人”。
feedback.direction: 计分方向越高，表示这些感受越容易通过表情或行动流露；越少外露，也不等于更平静或更会调节。表达得多或少都没有统一的好坏答案。
feedback.reflection: 想想最近一次不开心：你想让别人理解什么？你实际表达出来的内容，和心里想说的一样吗？
feedback.action: 可以试着把“你怎么总这样”换成“刚才发生这件事时，我有些生气，我希望……”。表达感受不等于吼叫、威胁或伤害别人；情绪很强时，先暂停一下也可以。
feedback.limits: 习惯、文化、关系安全感和具体场合都会影响表达。这个中文工作译稿尚待审核与验证，没有诊断分界值，也不能据此判断情绪控制能力。

population: 成人研究使用边界；非中文效度声明

versionNote: Current official 10-item key accessed 2026-10-25; retain exact item wording and official keys.
family: IPIP scales measuring seven components potentially related to emotional intelligence (Barchard, 2001); this isolated component is not a full emotional-intelligence test and is not another proprietary instrument.

deduplication.note: Also grep-checked repository keys and distinguishing first items; no matching instrument. Shared IPIP items do not mean duplicate complete scales.
